propositions: Ticket descriptions exceeding a configurable maximum (default 8,000 characters) must block both plan-review and completion-verification gates before any LLM or runner invocation.

Plan review must return deterministic BLOCK with coverage.llm_ran=false when description length exceeds the maximum; light-bug DET blocks must be partitioned to retain only the blocking P4 description finding while downgrading other DET blocks to advisory.
Completion verification must return a validated deterministic FAIL with zero runner calls when the authoritative ticket description exceeds the configured maximum after loading the verify setting.
The boundary is strict: exactly 8,000 characters is allowed; 8,001 or more characters blocks. AC-count and file-impact P4 signals remain advisory when description is within the maximum.
